articles.title: The Chequered Flag Podcast
articles.description: Has George Russell rediscovered his mojo after a lights-to-flag victory in Baku?

articles.title: 'Mr Saturday' Russell 'comes through other side after real tough period'
articles.description: George Russell described the Azerbaijan Grand Prix as "the most dominant weekend I've had in my career" after a win that felt like vindication.

articles.title: Russell faultless and Hadjar excellent on return - driver ratings
articles.description: BBC Radio 5 Live F1 commentator Harry Benjamin rates how the drivers performed during the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

articles.title: Norris says Colapinto should be banned after accident
articles.description: World champion Lando Norris calls for Alpine's Franco Colapinto to be banned for causing an accident at a restart at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

articles.title: Russell wins despite late Verstappen challenge
articles.description: Mercedes' George Russell holds off a late challenge from Red Bull's Max Verstappen to win an Azerbaijan Grand Prix enlivened by two late safety car periods.
